baseline_implementation: 1ab17af (VEP 0.6.0b1 candidate); every arm below is the same code with a VEP_PERF flag set, run in fresh processes in balanced random order

design.blocks: 10 valid blocks per size (6 at 3000 files), 2 warm-up blocks recorded and not analysed
design.pairing: within a block, same machine state; seeded shuffle of arm order
design.exclusions: a block is excluded only when some arm fails correctness (not certified, or bundle not AUTHORIZED); exclusions are listed and an arm with any exclusion cannot be adopted
design.statistics: preregistered Welch 95% interval of the relative difference and a paired bootstrap 95% interval (10,000 resamples); both must agree for adoption
design.cohorts: macOS local and hosted Linux are analysed separately and never pooled

wall_full_workflow.adopt_if: whole 95% interval of relative difference below -10% AND mean absolute gain above 50 ms, at 1,000 and 3,000 files

cpu_seconds.adopt_if: whole 95% interval of relative CPU difference below -10% AND absolute gain above 50 ms (declared before measuring)

cold_path_guard.reject_if: at 100 files the optimized arm is slower than baseline by more than 5% and 50 ms (interval entirely above +5%)

throughput_jobs_per_s.adopt_if: mean throughput gain of at least 10% with p95 job latency not worse by more than 10%, no stale commits, all candidates certified exactly once

memory.reject_if: peak RSS (largest child) grows by more than 25% at 3,000 files or the handoff cap is exceeded

correctness.adopt_requires: zero correctness regressions: the invariant suite (benchmarks/invariants) passes with the flag set, tests/test_staging_equivalence.py passes, and no unexplained cache hit

A1_staging_fast.change: create each directory once; create each staged file exclusively with O_NOFOLLOW at its final mode; no per-file mkdir/chmod by path
guards: distinct inodes, no link into the CAS

A2_staging_clone.change: macOS clonefile copy-on-write instead of reading the blob; hard links are never used; falls back to a normal write
guards: pre-run tree hash still verifies the staged tree
CAS blob unchanged after writes to the staged file

B_verified_handoff.change: one verifying read of each blob per evaluation (instead of three); verified bytes (bounded memory) are written during staging

C_policy_metadata_cache.status: analysed from the profile first; implemented only if pure computations remain a measurable share after A/B

D_resource_aware_scheduling.workloads: adaptive concurrency is implemented only if throughput improves without p95 latency regression

E_agent_fast_path.deliverable: explicit API with three never-substituted outcomes: FRESH_CERTIFICATE, DERIVED_ATTESTATION, ADVISORY_FEEDBACK

F_mcp_round_trips.measure: calls and bytes for a scripted coding sequence; change only if round trips fall without changing schemas incompatibly

claims_policy: no performance claim is published without a measurement record and a verdict from the rule above; negative results are kept
